sloka: स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः ।स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तेजस्वी स्थैर्यं कृत्वा महामतिः ।आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ।। ६.५९.६१ ।।।।
transliteration: sa talābhihatastena cacāla ca muhurmuhuḥ ।sthitvā muhūrtaṁ tejasvī sthairyaṁ kṛtvā mahāmatiḥ ।ājaghānābhisaṁkruddhastalenaivāmaradviṣam ।। 6.59.61 ।।।।

translations.english: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.
